note: Downtime window planning over a staged board (windows.py): three work-ready cases in scope — WIN-A CNC-3 spindle bearing wear (est 120, board priority 900), WIN-B WELD-4 weld drift (est 40, 500), WIN-C PACK-6 film shortage converged on the substitute (est 20, 312.5) — pack a Saturday 180-minute window (line-b + CNC-3/WELD-4/PACK-6/PRESS-1) exactly, in board order. Four staged PM obligations: PMO-W1 PRESS-1 hydraulics due before the window (est 150, priority 225 on the maintenance footing) defers with 0 minutes left; PMO-W2 CNC-2 cartridge (est 240) is oversized; PMO-W3 (fault with no SOP) is unestimated, never numbered; PMO-W4 is not due within the span and appears nowhere, as does WIN-E, an approved CONV-5 case outside the scope. An outcome recorded on WIN-B after computation makes confirmation refuse, naming WIN-B; the re-plan packs A + C (140 used, PMO-W1 still deferred) and confirms. A second window overlapping the first (10:30, 120 min) lists A and C as booked elsewhere and reads PMO-W1 oversized against its shorter length. Case records are byte-identical across planning and confirmation; the handoff at 07:00 names the confirmed window; counts read planned 2 / proposed 1 / confirmed 1.
